titulo: No Phone in the Morning: Cella Lasted Four Minutes
descripcion:
No phone in the morning, day one: Cella lasted four minutes. The neighbors saw everything. Day two, she puts the phone in the drawer and walks right past it.

How do you stop checking your phone first thing in the morning? Most people who manage it don't rely on willpower. They put the phone somewhere they can't reach from bed, like a drawer or another room, and start small: 10 minutes without it, then 30, then until after breakfast.

A cartoon about building a no-phone morning routine, one morning at a time.

comentario_fijado: How many minutes after waking up do you check your phone? Be honest.
alt: A 19-second vertical cartoon about no phone in the morning. Voice, no on-screen text. Bedroom at dawn. Two neighbor figures at the window gossip about Cella's no-phone rule. Cella, a small dark doorway-shaped figure with white eyes and a flat red crown, looks away from the phone on her nightstand until it buzzes, then the phone sticks to her. Next morning she pushes it into the drawer and walks past it to the window.
